page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, featuring 2 physical cores and 4 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core, along with a 33 MB L3 cache. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single bundled NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. The server delivers 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes no local disk storage.

Benchmark data reflects lower performance on general-purpose CPU and host memory operations, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core scores placing in the lower relative performance tiers. Uncached memory bandwidth tests similarly record lower throughput. However, the presence of the NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers high performance in machine learning inference tasks. In benchmark tests using a 7B parameter LLM, the instance achieves prompt processing speeds of 1,167.65 tokens per second and text generation throughput of 34.50 tokens per second.

The hardware configuration trades off CPU compute density for GPU acceleration efficiency. Operating without local disk storage necessitates external cloud storage volumes for persistent data. Offloading intensive matrix computations to the Turing T4 GPU optimizes cost efficiency relative to host CPU utilization. The instance is well suited for artificial intelligence inference, medium-scale language model execution, computer vision workloads, and GPU-accelerated video transcoding.
